# P35.54 — Templated nginx, config generations, metadata-only promotion (REL-03b)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/332_P35.54__config-generations-metadata-only-promotion.md`
(manifest row **332**, Round 11 / P35). Invoked `live_verification=false`
— no gate, not OM-20; leg runs: 0. Everything hosted is deferred: the
roll legs are engineered and composed-proven with injected runners, and
no production or staging mutation happens in this row. Owned:
**SIG-REL-006** (metadata-only promotion — a promote is a new immutable
configuration generation + a new revision env; release bytes are never
copied). Served: **SIG-OPS-004** (the release tool is the single writer of
`conf/<gen>` and the `releases/` index set — C4 NEW-10). Cited:
**SIG-REL-004/005** (P35.53's one-writer + immutability posture this row
builds on), **SIG-REL-002** (the promoted gate, enforced by construction),
**SIG-REL-013** (rollback/withdrawal — P35.55 owns the writers; this row
carries their fragments), **ADR-220** (written here), **ADR-132/ADR-156/
ADR-178** (the barriers and hashed-archive postures preserved verbatim),
**GT-9** (`SIG_STAGING` is a rendered constant, never a request input).
**Base:** `r11/P35.53-release-pipeline-and-staging-origins` (PR #351).
**Gate:** none. **New deferral:** `D-P35.54-1` — a disposition journaled
between a candidate's verify and its promote does not re-derive into the
carried `withdrawn.conf` for routes only the new pub serves; the P35.55
writer / V-suite owns the resolution (re-derivation or a re-verify gate).

## What landed

- **The G3 §4.2 envsubst template** (`ops/web/nginx.conf`) — the file is
  now a template, not a runnable config. `map $uri $uri_pub` extracts the
  publication id from `/r/`·`/s/`·`/releases/<pub>/` requests;
  `map $uri_pub $promoted` includes
  `conf/${SIG_CONF_GEN}/promoted.map` with `default 0` — an unpromoted
  namespace 404s **by construction**, there is no request path to the
  bytes, and staging's bypass is `${SIG_STAGING}` rendered at start
  (GT-9). The generation's `withdrawn.conf` / `selectors.conf` /
  `labels.conf` include inside the server block; the `/releases/` index
  surfaces (`index.html`, `catalog.json`, `latest.json`, plus a
  `/releases → /releases/` redirect) `root` into the conf generation.
  Every prior posture is preserved: the latest-view root
  (`/mnt/rel/staged/v/${SIG_LATEST_PUB}`), `/_astro/` immutable,
  P35.52's hashed-PMTiles immutable location + revalidating `/tiles/`,
  `/entity/` mutable stubs, the internal `/conf/tombstone/` location,
  `error_page 404`, `absolute_redirect off`, and the carried
  `chrome_*`/`terms_*`/`renamed_*` globs now reading `/mnt/rel/staged/
  conf/`. The dark `release_*.conf` glob is retired — the §6.3
  provenance pair (`X-SIG-Release "<label> <pub>"`,
  `X-SIG-Conf-Gen "<n>"` on every response incl. errors) renders from
  env via `ops/web/sig-headers.conf`, an include repeated per location
  because `add_header` does not inherit across `add_header`-declaring
  blocks.
- **`ops/web/sig-conf-entrypoint.sh`** (`docker-entrypoint.d/
  40-sig-conf.sh`) — renders the template only when `SIG_CONF_GEN` and
  `SIG_LATEST_PUB` are both set, **refuses a half-set env** (the
  container fails loudly, never silently legacy), and copies the frozen
  `ops/web/nginx-legacy.conf` verbatim when neither is set — the dark
  cutover roll is row 336's leg (ADR-220 D1). `SIG_ROBOTS_TAG_LINE`
  becomes the `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` directive on staging. Templates
  live outside `/etc/nginx/templates/` so the stock
  `20-envsubst-on-templates.sh` never double-renders them;
  `ops/web/Dockerfile` ships all four files and `nginx -t`s both the
  rendered release posture and the legacy fallback at build time.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** (~1,265 lines) — the conf-generation
  composer + promote engine. `plan_promotion` folds the event journal
  into the §3.4 lifecycle (a candidate must be `verified`/`classified`,
  must not carry a `promoted` event — re-promotion refuses toward
  P35.55's rollback rather than minting a generation), checks the
  `sig.promotion-approval/1` record (`registry/approvals/<name>.json`;
  class S requires a signed readout naming the pub; expiry and
  revocation honoured), and re-runs the V7 `api_parity_check` against
  the staged tree — invoked, never re-implemented. With `--apply` it
  writes `conf/<gen+1>` whole: `promoted.map` (carried set + the new
  pub), `latest.json` (`sig.latest-pointer/2`), `withdrawn.conf` +
  `selectors.conf` carried byte-identical, `labels.conf` re-composed
  from the label→pub alias set (G3 line 170), and the `releases/` index
  set (`index.html`, `catalog.json` as `sig.publication-catalog/2`,
  `latest.json`, `<label>/` alias stubs) — all generated by the release
  tool alone, **zero `staged/**` writes** (`copies_release_bytes:
  false`). Writes are resumable: an interrupted generation is
  recognised by its recorded intent and completed in place rather than
  minting `<gen+2>`. It then plans the roll legs — `sig-api` first,
  `sig-web` second (§5.1/§4.3: an api that can't serve the release is
  never publicly reachable), every image digest-pinned
  (`DIGEST_REF` shape), `min-instances=1` on web — through an injected
  runner, so the composed proof exercises the ordering without any
  hosted mutation. Success journals `promoted` with gen, label, class,
  approval ref, serving digests, and every leg's status; a failed api
  leg blocks the web leg and journals `failed`.
- **`sig-ops release promote`** (`release_pipeline.py` + `cli.py`) —
  the deferred skeleton is now the real verb: dry-run default,
  `--apply` for writes, registry LOCK + state-digest refresh +
  stale-generation refusal + `--break-lock` semantics unchanged from
  P35.53.
- **Compose `release-serving` profile** (`ops/docker-compose.yml`) —
  `web` gains the four release env vars (empty-defaulted: the profile-
  free `sig-ops up` still renders legacy) and the
  `${SIG_RELEASE_ROOT}:/mnt/rel:ro` mount; `web-staging` is the same
  image with `SIG_STAGING=1` pinned — the GT-9 staging origin,
  loopback-published only.
- **Tests** — `tests/ops/test_release_conf.py` (36 tests: generation
  contents, metadata carrying, releases-index generation, resume, gate
  refusals, approval classes, roll ordering + api-failure blocking,
  `copies_release_bytes`, rendered-template assertions);
  `tests/e2e/test_release_generations.py` (3 composed proofs over the
  real Docker stack: promoted `/r/<pub>/` 200 + provenance pair,
  unpromoted `/r/` 404, `/releases/`+`latest.json`+`catalog.json` served
  out of `conf/<gen>`, label alias 301, the staging origin ungated +
  `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, and a promote→roll→flip sequence with a
  scripted roll runner); `test_serving_topology_ops.py` updated to pin
  the template's fragment contract and the new compose shape.

  still refuses them naming their owner).
- The selector/`withBase` surfaces — P35.65 / P36.66a/b.
- The V1–V14 verification suite — P35.56/P35.58 (V7 is invoked, the
  suite is not re-implemented).
- The dark cutover roll to the release layout — row 336; the legacy
  config path stays a first-class fallback until then.
- Any hosted leg — D-R10-PUBLISH-1 and the OP-24 listing stand; nothing
  public was touched.

## Notes for reviewers

- nginx `map` regexes are deliberately unquoted and brace-free:
  `~"…"` parses but never matches inside a map block, and `{64}` is a
  block opener either way — the shape is loose (`p-[0-9a-f]+`) because
  strictness is the `default 0` gate's job. `map_hash_bucket_size 128`
  fits the 66-byte `p-<64hex>` keys.
- `/releases/` uses `root` into `conf/<gen>` (the URL structure mirrors
  the generation layout); an `alias`+`index` pair 500s on the directory
  request.
- The `promoted` gate and the latest view flip in the **same revision
  env** — there is no mixed-release serving window within a revision;
  `min-instances=1` keeps the latest view up across the roll.
